member.name: M:ICS.Database.TableObjects.RFS.RFS_WorkFlowScreen.FetchScreen(System.String,System.String,System.String,System.String,System.String)
member.summary: Fetches a screen based on the EnvironmentID, WorkflowID, Version, PageName, and DeviceType specified. If it fails to fetch a record, it will begin removing criteria. First, the Version is set to "Default", followed by setting the Workflow ID to the PageName and the version back to the original, followed by setting the Version to "Default", followed by removing the Workflow ID and setting the Version back to the original, followed by setting the Version to "Default", followed by removing the Environment ID and using the original Version, followed by setting the Version to "Default", followed by removing the Version.
member.param: Environment ID
Workflow ID
Version
Page Name
Device Type
member.returns: Returns true if a record is fetched for the specified EnvironmentID, WorkflowID, Version, PageName, and DeviceType; otherwise, false.
